ns2:section.sectionText: 1 hour. Graduate Seminar in Evolution. Topic: Speciation. This seminar will explore the current state of research on speciation, the evolution of new species, focusing on the role of adaptation to new niches/habitats as a central driving force. Students will prepare a bibliography, give a five minute introduction, and lead discussion on a recent paper or topic chosen from suggestions provided by the instructor; student participation in discussion is also required for credit. The instructor will give initial presentations on the history of key questions in speciation research as needed to provide time for preparation of student presentations. WILL MEET IN 407 MORRILL HALL
